Calibrating Atlantis model with atlantio and calibrar

2026-09-09

Source: vignettes/calibration/index.Rmd
index.Rmd

Semi-automatic callibration of the Lake Erie model using calibrar as described in @morell_ManualSemiautomated_2026.

library(atlantio)

Overall apporach

As described in @morell_ManualSemiautomated_2026, the goal of using calibrar is to automate the running of batch of simulations to improve model fit but also let modellers nodge the model to the right direction.

The idea is to run the model various time, optionnally revisit the set of paramters to shuffle as we go.

Difficulties exist given the tremendous number of parameters an Atlantis incude. Fortunately, a optimization tool such as calibrar (https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=calibrar).

steps:

  • designing the objective function

  • editing atlantis parameter files in, handles by atlantio (@morell_ManualSemiautomated_2026 uses https://github.com/alaiam/atlantis2ls)

  • running Atlantis model

  • computing the objective function

  • using callibrar
